dek: SkillHub, the OpenClaw-aligned AI skill community hosted by Tencent Lighthouse Cloud, now lists more than 100,000 AI skills and over 10 million monthly downloads. The TRACE evaluation framework is how the platform surfaces the 20 percent of skills that actually work.
